introduction.text: The Cappella della Visione di Sant'Ignazio di Loyola is a chapel in La Storta, Rome, where Saint Ignatius of Loyola had a pivotal vision that inspired the founding of the Society of Jesus. It is a significant pilgrimage site for Jesuits and those interested in Catholic mysticism.

history.description: In November 1537, Ignatius of Loyola, accompanied by Pietro Favre and Diego Laínez, stopped at a small chapel near La Storta and experienced a vision of Christ with the cross, which marked his spiritual calling.
After the vision, the Society of Jesus was founded in 1540, and the chapel became a site of veneration and pilgrimage.
During a bombing in May 1944, the original chapel was destroyed.
The chapel was rebuilt in 1944 and reopened in July 1983 after restoration.
A small chapel existed along the Via Francigena in La Storta before the 16th century.
